name: marque-testimonial
title: Marquee Testimonials
blurb: Two-row marquee with star-rated testimonial cards scrolling in opposite…
description: Continuous testimonial scroll display with two rows of cards moving in opposite directions (25s and 30s). Each card shows 5-star rating, quote icon, testimonial text, and author details (avatar, name, role, company). Includes gradient…
use_when: Social proof section requiring low-interaction display of multiple testimonials with continuous visual movement.
avoid_when: When testimonials need to be dynamic — data is hardcoded and not props-configurable.
a11y: Quote icons and star ratings are decorative (no text alternatives). Continuous scroll never pauses; no keyboard or prefers-reduced-motion support.
